description.content: Pick web page elements into the chat. Press the crosshair in a framed page, hover to highlight with tag / size / color / font, and one click writes the element's selector, XPath, attributes, computed styles, text and HTML into the composer. Ships an in-frame bridge, a fenced same-origin proxy for remote pages (SSRF re-checked per redirect hop, no cookies or credentials forwarded), and a React controller other plugins consume through window.__dshElementSelection__.

把网页元素点进聊天框。在框入的页面里按下十字准星，鼠标经过的元素高亮并显示 tag / 尺寸 / 颜色 / 字体，点一下就把它的选择器、XPath、属性、计算样式、文本与 HTML 写进输入框。含注入桥、供远端页面使用的受围栏代理（重定向逐跳复检 SSRF，不转发 cookie 与任何凭据），以及供其他插件通过 window.__dshElementSelection__ 取用的 React 控制器。
